info.title: MTN MoMo Open API
info.description: MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) Open API as published on the MTN MoMo developer portal (momodeveloper.mtn.com, Azure API Management): the Collection, Disbursement and Remittance products plus Sandbox User Provisioning. Each product is a separate APIM API mounted under its own path prefix (/collection, /disbursement, /remittance) on the same gateway host; sandbox provisioning lives at the host root. The OpenFn mtn-momo adaptor calls these paths with its generic request(), obtaining a bearer token from POST /collection/token/ with the API user and key, and always sending the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header.

servers.description: Production (live markets). X-Target-Environment is the market, e.g. mtnghana, mtnuganda.
Sandbox (X-Target-Environment: sandbox). The host the developer portal's APIM definitions name as serviceUrl.

post.description:
This operation is used to request a payment from a consumer (Payer). The payer will be asked to authorize the payment. The transaction will be executed once the payer has authorized the payment. The requesttopay will be in status PENDING until the transaction is authorized or declined by the payer or it is timed out by the system. 
 Status of the transaction can be validated by using the GET /requesttopay/\<resourceId\>

access_token.description: A JWT token which can be used to authrize against the other API end-points. The format of the token follows the JWT standard format (see jwt.io for an example). This is the token that should be sent in in the Authorization header when calling the other API end-points.

expires_in.description: The validity time in seconds of the token.

formatted.description: Full mailing address, formatted for display or use on a mailing label. This field may contain multiple lines, separated by newlines.

street_address.description: Full street address component, which may include house number, street name, Post Office Box, and multi-line extended street address information.

region.description: State, province, prefecture, or region component.

postal_code.description: Zip code or postal code component.

given_name.description: Given name(s) or first name(s) of the End-User. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple given names; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters.

family_name.description: Surname(s) or last name(s) of the End-User. Note that in some cultures, people can have multiple family names or no family name; all can be present, with the names being separated by space characters.

locale.description: End-User's locale, represented as a  BCP47 [RFC5646] language tag. As a compatibility note, some implementations have used an underscore as the separator rather than a dash, for example,  en_US; Relying Parties may choose to accept this locale syntax as well.

gender.description: End-User's gender. Values defined by this specification are female and male. Other values may be used when neither of the defined values are applicable.

login_hint.description: The identity of the account holder.
